changeSet.sql: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO dim.dim_country (country_iso3, country_id, country_name) SELECT DISTINCT country_iso3, country_id, country_name FROM read_parquet('/media/sandeep/DataDrive2/hedge-fund/datalake/data/silver/macro/observations.parquet') WHERE country_iso3 IS NOT NULL AND country_iso3 <> ''

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO dim.dim_indicator (indicator_id, indicator_name, source_id, unit) SELECT DISTINCT indicator_id, indicator_name, source_id, unit FROM read_parquet('/media/sandeep/DataDrive2/hedge-fund/datalake/data/silver/macro/observations.parquet') WHERE indicator_id IS NOT NULL

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM dim.dim_indicator WHERE indicator_id NOT IN ('UNK'); DELETE FROM dim.dim_country WHERE country_iso3 NOT IN ('UNK','USA','IND')
